title: Product lower bound for Gaussian stability
statement: Let $0<\rho<1$ and $a,b\in[0,1]$. If $(X,Y)$ is a pair of real random variables with joint law equal to the product of two standard Gaussian measures, then the probability that $\Phi(X)\le a$ and $\Phi(\rho X+\sqrt{1-\rho^2}\,Y)\le b$ is at least $ab$, where $\Phi$ is the standard Gaussian distribution function.
